title: Survivors of Nepal Flood Left in Stunned Disbelief: ‘They All Died, and I Lived’
summary_full: A visit near the border with Tibet laid bare the effects of a swollen river’s furious speed. Miles of devastation were left behind in a flash flood that killed more than 300.
